our_title: One unmapped vertex zeroes all load, neighbor and diameter statistics of the sequential map view
ran: gmtst src/check/data/m4x4.grf tgt/k2.tgt repro/PS2-G16-1/partial.map (vertex 0 absent from the map file; SCOTCH_graphTabLoad leaves it at -1), pristine 7.0.17 ASan build: 'M Processors 0/2 (0)', 'M Target min=0 max=0 avg=0 dlt=0 maxavg=0', 'M Neighbors min=0 max=0 sum=0', 'M PartDiam min=0 max=0 avg=0.000000' (comm lines are right). Patched: 'M Processors 2/2 (1)', 'M Target min=7 max=8 avg=7.5 ...', 'M Neighbors min=1 max=1 sum=2', 'M PartDiam min=6 max=7 avg=6.500000'. Also covered by src/check/test_scotch_graph_map_view (third view: Processors 2/8, Target 3/4).
location_7_0_17: src/libscotch/library_graph_map_view.c:302-309 (domntab built from all vertices, sorted; -1 labels sort first), 317 (loop stops at labl == ARCHDOMNOTTERM, which is -1), 383 (nghbtab[0] = -2 lets a -1 end vertex be inserted as a neighbor part)
evidence: 'domntab[vertnum].labl = parttax[vertnum];' for every vertex, then 'intSort2asc2 (domntab, grafptr->vertnbr);' and 'for (vertidx = 0; domntab[vertidx].labl != ARCHDOMNOTTERM; vertidx ++)' with '#define ARCHDOMNOTTERM ((ArchDomNum) ~0)' (arch.h:101): an unmapped vertex (-1) is sorted to index 0 and terminates every domain loop immediately, so mapnbr == 0. The comm loop at 462 explicitly skips '~0' vertices, and the twin SCOTCH_dgraphMapStat has a dedicated '-1' cell for unmapped vertices (library_dgraph_map_stat.c:189,194,436), so partial mappings are meant to be supported.

fix_options.label: A. Build the sorted domain array from mapped vertices only; sentinel so that unmapped ends never count as neighbors (patch)
fix_options.summary: Skip -1 vertices when filling domntab (give them pidx ~0), sort/iterate only the mapped ones, and set nghbtab[0] = ~0 so that an unmapped end vertex always matches the sentinel in the neighbor search.
fix_options.tested: gmtst partial/full/one-vertex maps (repro/PS2-G16-1/README), test_scotch_graph_map_view 0 and 1, all check targets listed in SUMMARY.md, 32- and 64-bit.
fix_options.tradeoffs: Statistics of partial mappings change from all-zero to meaningful; full mappings unchanged (verified on the shipped check data with one thread).
fix_options.maintainer_fit: Mirrors what SCOTCH_dgraphMapStat already does for unmapped vertices (its '-1' cell and 'nmskloctab[0] &= ~1'), keeps the existing TRICK sentinel style (library_graph_map_view.c:306 'TRICK: avoid testing (i+1)').

fix_options.label: B. Same filtering, explicit test instead of the sentinel trick
fix_options.summary: Identical domntab filtering, plus an explicit '(pidxend != ~0)' test in the neighbor loop.
fix_options.tested: compiles (gcc -c with the build flags); behaviour equivalent by reading
fix_options.tradeoffs: One more branch per arc; more readable than the sentinel.
fix_options.maintainer_fit: Acceptable; he tends to prefer sentinel tricks over per-arc tests.

fix_options.label: C. Reject partial mappings
fix_options.summary: errorPrint and return 1 when any vertex is -1.
fix_options.tradeoffs: Breaks gmtst on partial map files and SCOTCH_graphRemapView use cases where the comm loop already handles -1; contradicts the distributed twin.
fix_options.maintainer_fit: Unlikely: the code already has explicit '-1' handling at 462/466/486.

our_title: DgraphStatData.edlosum is reduced across processes but never assigned
why_not_run: no MemorySanitizer/valgrind on this box; the field is dead so no output depends on it
evidence: 'Gnum edlosum;' in DgraphStatData; 'inout->edlosum += in->edlosum;' in dgraphStatReduceAll; no 'srclstadat.edlosum =' anywhere; the output uses the separately reduced 'edloglbsum' ('*edlosumptr = (SCOTCH_Num) edloglbsum;'). The uninitialized stack field is sent through MPI_Allreduce.

fix_options.label: A. Remove the field and its reduction (patch)
fix_options.summary: Drop 'edlosum' from the struct, the reduce operator line, and shrink the MPI block length from 7 to 6 Gnums.
fix_options.tested: dstat repro on 1-3 processes, check_prog_dgtst (dgtst vs gtst diff) 32- and 64-bit
fix_options.maintainer_fit: His 7.0.17 commit a5ee23b 'Remove useless structure definition' is the same kind of cleanup.

fix_options.label: B. Initialize the field to zero
fix_options.maintainer_fit: He deletes unused fields rather than feeding them.

our_title: Distributed map view labels and spacing differ from the sequential view (Cmlosum, missing space)
ran: repro/API-18/dview_pristine on m4x4_b1_ev.grf k4.tgt, np 1: sequential 'M Processors 4/4 (1)' / 'M CommLoad[0]=0.644068' versus distributed 'M Processors 4/4(1)' / 'M Cmlosum[0]=0.644068'.
evidence:
'"M	Processors " GNUMSTRING "/" GNUMSTRING "(%g)
"' versus sequential '" (%g)
"'; '"M	Cmlosum[" ANUMSTRING "]=%f
"' versus sequential '"M	CommLoad["'. Neither label is documented in doc/ or the man pages.

fix_options.label: A. Align the distributed format on the sequential one (patch, separate commit)
fix_options.summary: Rename the histogram label to CommLoad and add the space, so that gmap -v and dgmap -v are comparable line for line.
fix_options.tested: dview differential identical line for line on 5 graph/target/process-count combinations; check_prog_dgpart.
fix_options.tradeoffs: Output-format change: any script grepping 'Cmlosum[' breaks. Kept as its own commit so it can be dropped.
fix_options.maintainer_fit: Plausible but his call; the sequential naming predates the distributed one.

fix_options.label: B. Leave the labels as they are
fix_options.tradeoffs: gmap -v and dgmap -v stay textually different.
fix_options.maintainer_fit: If he considers 'Cmlosum' a public label.
